info.title: ResQ foundation API
info.description: Implemented route inventory. Personal enrollment, recruitment and enterprise admission routes are implemented. Operational, billing and safety contracts remain planned in the seven-stage roadmap. No automatic retries for mutations; idempotency applies only where explicitly implemented. IDs preserve numeric legacy IDs or UUID strings; decimal values are strings; timestamps are UTC ISO-8601. Browser Firebase bearer adapter is supported; cookie mutations require an allowed Origin and X-Requested-With: VolunteerOps.
